primary: Lenient accuracy with unreadable replies counted as failures; strict and readable-only also reported.
strict: Entire trimmed text is one JSON object with exactly winner, confidence, reason. Winner A/B uppercase; finite numeric confidence 0..100; nonempty reason string. Two-sentence request is not machine enforced. Decisions: schema/probability checks.
lenient: First complete JSON object; normalize winner case/whitespace and numeric confidence strings. If JSON fails to parse AND native finish_reason is length, allow only an anchored object header with complete winner/confidence followed by a nonempty unfinished reason string. No verdict inferred from free prose. Original complete-JSON lenient scores and strict scores are also exported.
inference: 5000 item-cluster bootstrap draws, stratified by family; both orders stay together. Pairwise aligned item differences with bootstrap intervals; two-sided exact sign test on nonzero item-level differences and Holm adjustment.
missing: Unreadable separated into empty, no_parseable_json, schema_failure, refusal, timeout, transport_error. No answer-content retry. Retries only on 429, rate limit, 5xx, or truncated OpenRouter output; all attempts cached/costed.
solves: Every text judge solves the 120 code/worked tasks independently. Wrong-solve disagreement proxy: rejects correct candidate on a readable but wrong solve. This is association, not evidence of remembered own output; solve and judge calls do not share context.
subtlety_bins: Code failed hidden-test share: <=.05, (.05,.2], >.2; worked relative error <=1e-5, (1e-5,.01], >.01; instructions broken constraint; grounded distractor type. Fixed before test.
dev_rule: If Opus and Sol each >=23/24 in EACH order, draw a new development set at the next whole-family level. Up to12levels; unfinished level9 skipped for an objective construction amendment; freeze prohibited if the ceiling rule still triggers at the final level12.
writer_rule: Held-out levels4+: passing answers must be actual normalized cached writer replies, never direct generated-reference repairs. Two natural requests, then up to eight reference-assisted requests alternating available writers. Prefer an eligible unmutated failing writer answer; for worked pairs choose closest available length. Otherwise mutate an actual passing writer reply. Fail closed if no verified writer-derived pair exists.
mutation_limitation: Final worked mutations carry one recorded arithmetic slip through later exact stages; grounded mutations replace a coherent distractor fact, source ID and final result. Candidate writing can be reference-assisted, but no final passing candidate is a direct oracle substitution.
code_test_rule: 64 distinct input cases, stratified using reference vs fixed template mutation: 56 matching/8 differing at level1, 62/2 at higher levels. Natural bug pass shares can differ. This ensures a subtle deterministic fallback; hidden tests are withheld.
cost_estimation: Anthropic reports CLI total_cost_usd. Codex uses reported tokens at public list prices. Muse Full has no published token list price or usage returned: explicit proxy at Wonder 4/20 USD per million tokens, chars/4; not actual spend. Do not rank proxy as measured billing.
solve_numeric_reading: Strict: entire JSON object, exactly code/answer field, string value; worked answer one signed integer/decimal/fraction string. Lenient: first complete JSON object, extra fields allowed, worked numeric JSON values parsed with Decimal to preserve digits or strings with optional Final answer prefix and credit/litre/unit/cent suffix; no multiline expression or arithmetic evaluation. Code strings are run after normal fence normalization. Valid JSON containing broken/nonterminating Python counts wrong, with execution_error; outer parse/schema/refusal/request failures are unreadable.
openrouter_json_mode: Native JSON object mode on BOTH OpenRouter text judges after smoke format/latency probes; same prompt text for every text judge. CLIs request inner JSON in text, so output-format enforcement differs by access path.
hardness_amendment: After Opus and Sol were 24/24 in both orders on all three initial draws, whole-family levels4+ add stateful code audits, 7/9/11 further exact settlement adjustments, varied hyphen/apostrophe word counting, and backdated/withdrawn per-field contract versions. No test judgment had been collected.
hard_candidate_eligibility: Code worse passes >=90% of hidden cases with no runtime errors. Both worked candidates are >=3 nonempty lines and >=25 alphabetic words, with canonical reduced-fraction/integer final representation; wrong relative error <=1e-4 and numerator/denominator at most two digits shorter than gold. Instruction count failures differ by exactly one word. Grounded answers use the exact requested one-sentence ID/fact/equation form; natural failures match one coherent generated one-field distractor.
instruction_hardness: Levels4/5/6 choose word-count mutation with probabilities .7/.8/.9; other failed constraints sampled uniformly. Optional-word deletion or modifier insertion keeps remaining checks unchanged. Hyphenated/apostrophe wording and varying counts prevent whitespace-token shortcuts.
solve_presentation: Worked solve_task contains the identical mathematical problem and all adjustments but omits the candidate-writing request for intermediate steps/final-label form. The solving condition independently requests one JSON scalar. No candidates, oracle values, tests, or previous judgments are supplied.
agreement_definition: Canonical winners compared on the same order among readable replies. An item splits judges if either order disagrees, even if averaged accuracies tie. Readable wrong in both orders is distinct from primary failure in both orders and from any unreadable reply.
latency_definition: Sum of measured transport durations over prescribed attempts, excluding queue/backoff and implementation gaps; overall wall spans reported separately.
final_development_draw: Use fresh suffix b draws at levels4+ after incomplete first hard draw was drained for provenance/reading-rule audit. No test judgments collected before this amendment; incomplete draw outcomes not used to tune individual items.
decisions_options: Actual displayed answer texts are the A/B choice criteria. State contains the common judge preface plus task/source; no JSON-output request in the typed state. Displayed A/B maps back to canonical candidates using order. This replaced generic option references during pretest audit, before any test request.
passing_answer_provenance: Reference-assisted writing is disclosed and not an independent writer-solve benchmark. Earlier diagnostic levels1-3 and incomplete draw4 contained prototype reference repairs and are excluded from held-out data. Final replay validates every passing candidate against its cached writer raw answer.
code_execution_contract: Candidate runs as module candidate with guarded standard-library imports: math, decimal, fractions, collections, itertools, functools, datetime, calendar, re, statistics, bisect, heapq, operator, string, typing, copy, json, ast, dataclasses, numbers, unicodedata. These allowed modules are disclosed in final task text. Four-second subprocess timeout; no file/network tools are needed.
writer_transcription_amendment: After the fresh hard development construction failed for9of24pairs, a four-family tiny probe showed copy-only JSON transcription succeeds where combining task-solving and reference copying failed. Reference-assisted requests now use the isolated transcription template; natural requests and task generators unchanged. All actual candidate provenance remains cached; no direct oracle substitution. Fifteen already valid writer-derived pairs retained, nine incomplete pairs resumed. No hard development judgments or test judgments existed at this amendment.
code_mutation_amendment: Two copied hard development code answers were correct but had no qualifying comparison/unary mutation; their main rules used min/capped arithmetic or string status. For all code templates, if an actual writer AST equals the reference AST, the known generator-template bug may be applied to that actual parent as a recorded worse-answer mutation. Eligibility and all64tests remain identical; no direct passing reference replacement. No hard dev/test verdicts existed.
capacity_retry_amendment: One Sol hard-development call returned a cached at-capacity turn.failed event. Before test, the existing three-attempt transport retry rule was extended to explicit capacity/temporary-unavailable error events, without inspecting answer text or changing prompts/parsers. All attempts are preserved and costed.
extended_difficulty_amendment: After level6 still met the ceiling trigger (Opus23/24,24/24; Sol24/24,24/24), add levels7-9 before test: instruction bodies target1000/1600/2400regex words; signed arithmetic slips; randomly permute12code templates by split/level (earlier dev covered templates0-5 only); canonicalize both generated code reference/mutation formatting. Full test still covers5items/template. Writer output budgets adapt to reference length up to6400. No test verdict or per-item selection.
numerator_slip_amendment: Before test, source inspection found that the fixed1/10000slip could introduce denominator-pattern shortcuts. Levels8+ instead change a middle digit of the current exact numerator by signed10**floor(digits/2), over its existing denominator, then carry the changed amount through all remaining stages. This is a whole-worked-family construction rule; no individual judge errors were used. Incomplete dev8bwriter drafts are archived and replaced by fresh dev8c/dev9c draws. Natural attempts and other final family rules remain unchanged.
solve_subgroups: Report both aggregate and within-family code/worked solve rates and judge accuracy conditional on solved/wrong/unreadable solves. Fixed before test; subset counts and intervals exported. This is descriptive association, not causal self-preference.
cache_layout: Full-request keyed JSONL. If the returned-response ledger exceeds75MB, final packaging gzip-compresses it losslessly to cache_requests.jsonl.gz, retaining an empty appendable cache_requests.jsonl. Replay loads archive then active ledger and probes, validates every key, and verifies byte hashes before/after. Original uncompressed SHA and counts are saved in cache_archive_manifest.json.
long_writer_chunk_amendment: Two fresh dev8c long-message copies repeatedly omitted sentences. Before any dev8c/test verdict, add same-model chunk transcription for all level8+ instruction items without a passing natural answer: split at sentence/paragraph boundaries into<=2200characters, exact-check each actual returned chunk, retry authoring up to8times, join only verified returned text with recorded whitespace separators. No generated reference is substituted. Existing22verified pairs retained; final replay verifies each chunk cache key and reconstruction. This is data authoring, not a judge retry.
micro_error_bins: Before test, worked relative-error bins adapted to the numerator-digit construction: <=1e-20, (1e-20,1e-15], >1e-15. Objective values only; no test or item-level judge outcomes used. All original thresholds remain in archived pretest plans.
distinct_sentence_operand_amendment: After level8 again triggered the ceiling rule, a construction audit found repeated clauses made edits stand out and post-adjustment slips could violate the multiplier divisibility grid. Before test, unfinished dev9c was drained/archived without using verdicts. New levels10-12 use distinct generated English sentences (targets700/1000/1400words), balanced plausible adjective insertion/deletion at random eligible positions, balanced numerator-slip signs within each worked template over60items, and a middle-numerator operand slip BEFORE the selected adjustment rather than after its multiplication. These whole-family rules are fixed before fresh suffix-d draws; no test or individual wrong-item selection.
prefix_reading_amendment: After dev10passed difficulty (Opus46/48,Sol44/48), five Granite final retries had explicit winner/confidence but an unfinished reason. Before any test request, add conservative generic truncated-prefix recovery, retain complete-JSON-only and strict scores per item/summary, and validate positive/negative contracts. No request/prompt or item changes; all5rawreplies preserved. Solves do not use prefix recovery because clipped code/numeric strings are ambiguous.
validation_evidence: pretest_validation.json: 720 generated-item checks plus solve-reading, cross-order agreement, typed-choice and writer-provenance contracts, all before the final live draw.
supplemental_intervals: Before any test verdict: strict/readable-only score and pairwise readable agreement intervals use the same stratified item-cluster bootstrap. Order consistency and its readable subset use Wilson over items; first-position picks use item-cluster bootstrap over readable orders.
quota_stop_policy: Usage/quota/credit-limit patterns in CLI stdout, stderr and complete JSON event streams stop the entire collector without retrying. Such attempts and replies drained after the stop go to nonfinal_attempts.jsonl, never the final response cache. Every new transport start/return is journalled in attempt_lifecycle.jsonl. Earlier cache/attempt files audited before resume; no quota replies found. Generator, prompts, evaluation and development reading rules unchanged.
